response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Order_Items), p AS (SELECT pr.product_id, pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS aq, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS c, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT n FROM total) AS s FROM Products pr JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pr.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY pr.product_id, pc.product_type_description), t AS (SELECT d, AVG(aq) AS a, AVG(c) AS c, AVG(s) AS s FROM p GROUP BY d) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_product_quantity, AVG(c) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(s) AS avg_share_of_order_items FROM t
